newsitem.title: USA: FTC staff seeks ad case vs RJ Reynolds - Journal.
newsitem.headline: FTC staff seeks ad case vs RJ Reynolds - Journal.

text.p: Federal Trade Commission staff investigators are asking the agency to bring an unfair advertising case against RJ Reynolds Tobacco Co, claiming its Camel cigarette campaigns are aimed at young people, the Wall Street Journal said Wednesday.
FTC director of consumer protection Jodie Bernstein cited new evidence about tobacco company advertising tactics in a memo and recommended the agency take steps against RJ Reynolds, the paper said.
The memo was sent two weeks ago, it said.

FTC spokeswoman Victoria Streitfeld was quoted as saying in the Journal: "The commission is being presented new evidence and will respond to it accordingly. The company will be given the full opportunity to meet with commissioners before they vote."
RJ Reynolds, a unit of RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp, was not immediately available to comment.
RJR was quoted as saying that there was no substantive research that indicated anything different related to advertising tactics.
